verdicts.strongest_argument: The finding is internally at war with itself. If the shelf and the 144 notices caused the 25% slide, then the supply has already been absorbed by the tape and the effect is in the price - which is the strongest form of 'already priced' available to me; if they did not cause it, the coincidence of dates is the whole argument and there is nothing left. The hunter cannot have both 'coincides exactly with a supply event' and 'nobody has connected it'. All five accessions are in filings.json with acceptance times - the S-3 0001437749-26-022501 on 2026-07-02, the EFFECT 9999999995-26-002338 on 2026-07-17, the two 144s on 07-09 and 07-10, the Form 4 on 07-13 - so the sequence was reachable to any EDGAR reader eight weeks ahead, which is the reachable-but-unconnected band, and the corpus stores no body for any of them, so no size is established for the shelf or the notices. The mechanism also does not reach forward: the finding itself notes no filing of any kind in the seven weeks into the print, and the baseline shows run_up_20d of only -6.51% against the 25% peak-to-print decline, so the July supply pressure is spent and the recent tape is quiet. What remains is the interpretive claim that the drawdown was technical rather than fundamental and therefore reverses on a decent print - an assertion about the reason for a price move, made from the price move, with no dated source. The 10-K risk-factor language about concentrated-holder selling is boilerplate that appears in the risk factors of essentially every sponsor-backed issuer and cannot corroborate a specific July sale.

prior_publication.what_it_says: An S-3 registration statement was filed and publicly indexed on EDGAR two months before the print, declared effective 2026-07-17 per the EFFECT notice in the same file.

verdicts.baseline_evidence: quote.json/baseline: spot 9.05, pct_from_52w_high -24.9%, run_up_20d -6.51%, run_up_5d -4.03%, avg_volume_20d 155,955 and realised_vol_20d only 30.5%. The 25% decline the finding rests on is concentrated in July, around the filing dates it cites - i.e. the tape moved when the information became available, which is the textbook case for scoring it in the price. The last twenty sessions are a quiet -6.5% drift with no distribution spike, so no unabsorbed supply overhang is visible going into the print.
verdicts.what_would_change_it: The S-3 body showing a resale registration of a specific, large concentrated block still unsold, sized against the 156k-share daily volume, which would make the overhang forward-looking rather than historical.

verdicts.strongest_argument: This restates published guidance and then does the arithmetic backwards. The FY26 raise - revenue $410-425m, adjusted EBITDA $98-105m, FCF at least $45m - was in the 2026-06-04 release, is in the captured Stocktwits body at the 2026-06-04T20:18:01Z entry (docs/b56e9371bd04e596d5a459214b6f5deabf719b47.txt), and the market repriced it violently and immediately: the baseline's own history records +30.70% on that print, the largest reaction in the seven-event set. Guidance that produced a 31% up-move is the definition of priced. The 'unaggregated arithmetic' is also weaker than claimed and arguably points the other way. Against $197.4m reported in H1, the $410-425m range requires $213-228m in H2, which is only 8-15% above H1 - and for an October fiscal year end, H2 is the seasonally strong half containing the summer construction season, so a mid-single-digit to low-teens sequential half-on-half step is the ordinary seasonal shape rather than a stretch. Presenting that as tension misreads the seasonality the finding elsewhere relies on. Finally, the citation is mismatched: source_date is 2026-06-04 but the source URL is the 2026-03-10 Q1 FY26 release, so the document being cited is not the document containing the raise.

prior_publication.what_it_says: The cited URL is the Q1 FY26 release; the captured Stocktwits body carries the 2026-06-04 Q2 release with the raised FY26 guide, both public months before the print.

verdicts.baseline_evidence: Baseline history: 2026-06-04 amc reaction +30.70%, the largest in the set, on the release that carried this guide. Since then the stock has given back to 9.05 with realised_vol_20d of 30.5% and no volume build. The guide is therefore not just published but was the subject of the single biggest repricing in this name's recent history.
verdicts.what_would_change_it: A dated third-quarter datapoint - a competitor's volume commentary, a data-centre project deferral, a cement or ready-mix volume series - showing the H2 requirement had become unreachable after 06-04.

interactions: Both findings are drawn from the same two corpus objects (filings.json and the single 90-message Stocktwits body), and the hunter concedes this in #1's independence field. They also conflict: #0 needs the 25% decline to be technical and unrelated to fundamentals, while #1 needs the decline to represent the market walking away from an unachievable guide. Only one of those can be the explanation of the same bars.
corpus_limits: No body is stored for the S-3, the EFFECT, either 144 or the Form 4, so no supply size is verifiable in this capture. BBCP carries no news items, so there is no sell-side preview or consensus estimate to test the guidance claim against - that absence is a capture artefact, not evidence the market lacked one. The Stocktwits stream's eight-week gap is likewise a property of the dump, not of market attention. I did not open docs/352e5565c8c4c0d3898f5a4ba5c6d316d29af018.txt.
